name: pypng
description: Pure Python library for saving and loading PNG images
unavailable_reason: Repository is on gitlab. Using deps.dev for cross-forge analysis.

readme.summary: README covers the basics well but is dominated by release notes and lacks substantive examples, configuration docs, or troubleshooting guidance.
readme.top_issue: No troubleshooting section and almost no configuration documentation beyond a single quick-start snippet; release notes consume most of the document.

common_complaints: Bugs with specific data types (numpy arrays, bytes, iterators)
Unresolved functionality gaps (APNG support, chunk ordering)
Type errors and API inconsistencies (bytes handling, write_packed)
Security vulnerabilities (jQuery CVE lingering in docs)
praise_themes: Core library functionality appreciated when it works
Users grateful for the tool despite issues
sentiment.summary: pypng is in slow-maintenance mode with critical bugs (2019-2022) and feature requests left unaddressed for 3-5+ years, indicating limited active development and maintainer engagement despite ongoing user need.

concerns: No commits for nearly 3 years (last on 2023-04-12)
